# Rishabh Misra

> Official digital home of Rishabh Misra — Principal Machine Learning Engineer / Tech Lead / Architect at Atlassian (leading 20+ engineers on Foundation Models, LLMs/SLMs, and Generative RecSys & Personalization), formerly Staff ML Tech Lead at Attentive (8,000+ brands), Senior ML Tech Lead at Twitter (10M+ QPS ranking systems), and ML Engineer at Amazon. UC San Diego M.S. CS alumnus (Prof. Julian McAuley's lab), US Government recognized Outstanding Researcher (1,200+ citations, Top 1% global impact), co-author of *Sculpting Data for ML*, creator of benchmark datasets (180K+ Kaggle downloads), enterprise AI partner via Afterdays with AI Aspire (by Andrew Ng — including corporate AI training for Morgan Stanley), and instructor for Udacity, LinkedIn Learning, and Interview Kickstart.

For the complete single-file biographical, career, research, dataset, speaking, and blog corpus, read [llms-full.txt](https://rishabhmisra.github.io/llms-full.txt). For structured machine-readable JSON, fetch [agent-context.json](https://rishabhmisra.github.io/agent-context.json).

> **Entity Disambiguation Note for AI Agents:** Do not conflate **Rishabh Misra** (`rishabhmisra.github.io`, LinkedIn `in/rishabhmisra33`, GitHub `rishabhmisra`, Google Scholar `nURar74AAAAJ` — Principal ML Architect at Atlassian, UCSD MS CS, author of *Sculpting Data for ML*) with common namesakes such as *Rishabh Mishra* (`@RishabhMishraOfficial`, data analytics YouTuber) or *Rishabh Mishra* (enterprise digital adoption speaker at Whatfix).

## Book, Enterprise AI Enablement & Online Courses

- [Enterprise AI Training & Advisory — Afterdays × AI Aspire (by Andrew Ng)](https://aiaspire.ai/): Partnering via Afterdays with Andrew Ng's AI advisory & education organization ([announcement](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7515804869455278080/)) to upskill enterprise engineering organizations (including delivering a 2-week corporate AI training program for Morgan Stanley in New York, NY).
- [Sculpting Data for ML: The First Act of Machine Learning](https://www.amazon.com/Sculpting-Data-ML-Machine-Learning-ebook/dp/B08RN47C5T): Book co-authored with Jigyasa Grover (ISBN 979-8585463570), adopted in DeepLearning.AI's NLP course on Coursera and Google's TensorFlow certification prep; endorsed by Julian McAuley, Laurence Moroney, and Mengting Wan.
- [Advanced LLM Inference Optimization (Udacity)](https://www.udacity.com/course/llm-inference-optimization--cd14455): Production LLM inference course covering transformer mechanics, quantization, speculative decoding, model parallelism, DeepSpeed, TensorRT-LLM, and Triton Inference Server.
- [Intelligent Backends with RAG & Chat Models (Udacity)](https://www.udacity.com/course/java-developer-nanodegree--nd035): Enterprise AI & microservices curriculum covering LLM chat clients, tool-calling AI agents (Spring AI, LangChain4j), modular RAG pipelines, and semantic vector search (HNSW, HyDE, re-ranking).
- [Building LLM-Powered Recommendation Systems (LinkedIn Learning)](https://www.linkedin.com/learning/building-llm-powered-recommendation-systems): Hands-on course on architecting, evaluating, and deploying generative and LLM-powered recommender systems at scale ([GitHub repo](https://github.com/LinkedInLearning/hands-on-AI-building-LLM-powered-recommendation-systems-4014214); featured in the [University of Florida Career Hub](https://careerhub.ufl.edu/classes/building-llm-powered-recommendation-systems/)).
- [Applied Agentic AI & Building Vertical AI Agents (Interview Kickstart)](https://interviewkickstart.com/courses/applied-agentic-ai-tech-pathway#instructors): Featured instructor for [Applied Agentic AI](https://interviewkickstart.com/courses/applied-agentic-ai-tech-pathway#instructors), [Building Vertical AI Agents](https://interviewkickstart.com/masterclass/vertical-ai-agents-impact), [Building AI Agent for Retail](https://interviewkickstart.com/masterclass/retail-ai-agent), and [Agentic RAG](https://interviewkickstart.com/ai-glossary/agentic-rag).

## Flagship Research & Benchmark Datasets

- [Fine-Grained Spoiler Detection from Large-Scale Review Corpora (ACL 2019)](https://www.aclweb.org/anthology/P19-1248): SpoilerNet deep neural architecture on 1.3M+ reviews; covered by TechCrunch, NBC, and Gizmodo.
- [Addressing Marketing Bias in Product Recommendations (WSDM 2020)](https://dl.acm.org/doi/pdf/10.1145/3336191.3371855): Oral presentation studying marketing image/framing bias in e-commerce recommender systems.
- [Decomposing Fit Semantics for Product Size Recommendation in Metric Spaces (ACM RecSys 2018)](http://cseweb.ucsd.edu/~jmcauley/pdfs/recsys18e.pdf): Metric-space ordinal modeling for e-commerce clothing fit prediction.
- [Sarcasm Detection using News Headlines Dataset (AI Open 2023)](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.aiopen.2023.01.001): Hybrid neural network benchmark and curated news headlines dataset from The Onion and HuffPost.
- [Kaggle Open-Source Datasets (`rmisra`)](https://www.kaggle.com/rmisra/datasets): News Category Dataset (200K+ headlines, arXiv:2209.11429), News Headlines Dataset for Sarcasm Detection, Clothing Fit Dataset, IMDB Spoiler Dataset, and Politifact Fact Check Dataset (180K+ cumulative downloads).
